questions.question: Who is the first version for?
questions.recommendedChoice: Beauty shoppers who want a focused way to discover cosmetics

options.label: Beauty shoppers
options.description: People browsing and comparing cosmetics before buying.

options.label: Beauty enthusiasts
options.description: People tracking products, ingredients, and personal preferences.

options.label: Makeup beginners
options.description: People who need guided product and routine recommendations.

questions.question: What should the primary first-visit workflow be?
questions.recommendedChoice: Browse products, filter by need, and view a focused product detail

options.label: Browse and compare
options.description: Explore a catalog, filter it, and compare product details.

options.label: Build a beauty routine
options.description: Choose goals and steps, then assemble a personalized routine.

options.label: Get a guided recommendation
options.description: Answer a short set of questions and receive product suggestions.

questions.question: Which product direction should define the first version?

options.label: Catalog / store
options.description: A polished cosmetic product browsing and shopping experience.

options.label: Beauty routine tool
options.description: A tool for planning, saving, or refining a skincare or makeup routine.

options.label: Virtual try-on
options.description: An experience centered on previewing cosmetic shades or looks.

questions.question: Which visual direction should guide the draft?
questions.recommendedChoice: Editorial beauty: luminous, refined, and image-led

options.label: Editorial beauty
options.description: Luminous, refined, image-led, with magazine-like typography.

options.label: Clinical minimal
options.description: Clean, calm, ingredient-aware, and highly structured.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a typed Astro frontend.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use standard JavaScript in Astro components.

questions.question: Which data stores does the first version need?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use static or mock product content for the first draft.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Store products, routines, accounts, or other structured data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store product images, uploads, or other media.

questions.question: Should users sign in for application features in the first version?

options.label: No
options.description: Keep the first experience public and frictionless.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Support user-specific features such as saved routines or favorites.
